caveats: Threshold pools use the prescribed +/-5-day windows, extending the 1992-2002 baseline to 1991-12-27..2003-01-05; 90th percentile computed with numpy quantile method='hazen' (Hyndman-Fan type 5), day-60 value set to mean of days 59/61, then both fields smoothed with a wrapped 31-day centred moving mean. 313 of 3600 regional cells were excluded as non-sea cells (SST missing on at least one target day). The warmest 2012 signal (3 consecutive hot days Aug 17-19 in a few northern cells) did not reach the 5-day MHW minimum, so no per-cell MHWs and no regional events were detected; the mask is all zero.
